postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql:
UPDATE "FinancialInstitution" SET "creditCardRules"=('{"cashback":null,"workingDueDate":true,"transitionMode":"EXTRA_CYCLE","installmentMode":"PER_CYCLE"}'::jsonb || COALESCE("creditCardRules"::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb))::json WHERE lower("name")='nubank';
UPDATE "FinancialInstitutionProfile" p SET "creditCardRules"=('{"cashback":null,"workingDueDate":true,"transitionMode":"EXTRA_CYCLE","installmentMode":"PER_CYCLE"}'::jsonb || p."creditCardRules"::jsonb)::json FROM "FinancialInstitution" i WHERE i.id=p."institutionId" AND lower(i.name)='nubank' AND p."creditCardRules" IS NOT NULL;
